about: Raises a short message into a region fixed to an edge of the window, and removes it after its duration. A pointer resting on the region, or focus inside it, pauses every toast, and Alt+T moves focus to the region. A screen reader hears each new toast through the region's polite live region. A toast that is missed is gone, so nothing a reader needs is only in one.

kinds.about: The five types. The type sets the toast's palette, which the indicator reads, and its duration: 2 seconds for `success`, 5 for the others, and no timer for `loading`.

promise.about: `promise` raises one loading toast and rewrites it as the work settles: the success in its place, or the error. The first trigger settles after 2 seconds, the second fails after 2 seconds.
promise.title: Promise

queue.about: The toaster shows 5 toasts at a time and queues the rest. The trigger raises 8 at once: 5 show, and the others arrive as those close.
queue.heading: Line not matched
queue.title: Queue

region.about: The region an application renders once, at its root, for one toaster. Its render function returns each toast's parts: the indicator's glyph by type, the title, the description, the action and the close button. A trigger anywhere in the application raises into the same toaster.
region.description: Your changes to the payout schedule are saved.

region.title: Region

sync.about: A toast raised with an id is rewritten in place through `update`. The report starts as a loading toast, changes its description after 1.5 seconds and turns into a success after 3.
sync.heading: Reconciling
sync.title: Updated in place

title: Toast

undo.about: A toast with an action. A press on Undo runs the action, then dismisses the toast. The toast closes after 10 seconds, which gives a reader time to reach the button.
undo.heading: Payout removed
undo.title: Action
